name: pabrisson
description: Claude Code plugins from Pabrisson's config: mods, hooks, agents, commands and skills

plugins.name: mod-hud
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: model, effort, folder, branch, tool activity, usage bars, context, cost and updates

plugins.name: mod-ports
plugins.description: Right pane listing what runs for the project (Docker swarm and containers, Kubernetes, local processes) with its state, links and restart, toggled from the hud's icon

plugins.name: mod-code-fence
plugins.description: Wraps code pasted into the prompt in a ```lang fence, so md-prompt draws it as a code card

plugins.name: hook-notify
plugins.description: Desktop notification (macOS, Linux, Windows) when Claude finishes or waits for input, with each prompt's duration logged to SQLite (ccnotify)

plugins.name: command-toolbox
plugins.description: Command fork-sync (sync a fork with upstream)

plugins.name: skill-laravel
plugins.description: Skill laravel-upgrade: upgrade Laravel one major version at a time with test pauses

plugins.name: skill-video
plugins.description: Skill video-editor: edit a video of any genre from one or several rushes and B-roll, or create one from scratch in motion design, rendered locally in every format, with captions, synthesized music and sound, a review studio, editing rule packs and a style that learns

plugins.name: skill-immo
plugins.description: Skill property-search: find property for sale in France (flats, houses, plots, parkings, premises) around an address, a street or a neighborhood, weigh each against the real sales of its type, its building, its neighborhood, the rent and the buyer's budget, write offer letters, in a local dashboard; listings from the Stream Estate API (paid, with the user's yes on every credit) or found by Claude

plugins.name: requesty
plugins.description: MCP server Requesty (router.requesty.ai): Sentry tools through the Requesty router

plugins.name: dbeaver
plugins.description: MCP server DBeaver (omnisql-mcp): query the connections of the local DBeaver workspace
